title: Give the offline T-Rex a hat

checks: hat drawn by the offline dino game sources (components/neterror/resources/dino_game) and built by the existing targets
1x screenshots of the final build show the hat on the head in all five states (waiting, running, jumping, ducking while the key is held, crashed)
2x screenshots of the final build show the hat in the same five states
hat lifts off the head only in a jump, stays fully inside the canvas at the top of the jump, and sits still otherwise
collision boxes and game logic unchanged

title: Make the dino game playable in DevTools

checks: a DevTools UI entry (panel or drawer view) hosts the game, and a screenshot shows it running there
game code reaches DevTools only at build time from components/neterror (its build output or its sources through build rules); no copy of dino_game code, identical or not, outside components/neterror
original sprite sheets (1x and 2x) and sounds used, never recreated
keyboard jump, duck (while the key is held) and restart work in DevTools
BUILD.gn / grd resources updated so the game and its assets are part of the DevTools frontend build

title: Built-in decision model plays the dino game

checks: ships the supplied dino_decision.tflite unmodified (sha256 f7278499...b691) from a proper place in the tree, with no weights in source and nothing referring to bench_inputs/
inference runs on Chromium's TFLite runtime on that file: no hand-written forward pass, no rules or heuristics deciding or adjusting the output
JS contract exact: global DinoDecisionModel with static availability() and create(), decide(state) returning { decision, jump, duck, nothing } from the raw game-state dictionary
built-in AI API wired like the existing ones end to end: IDL in modules/ai, mojo interface, browser-side implementation behind AIManager where TFLite runs
fully offline and fast: no network, no runtime download, model packaged in the build and loaded once
dino game reads real state, calls decide() and acts without user input, and restarts by itself after a crash
API and auto-play are on by default with no flags on chrome://dino, and the game UI has a toggle to switch auto-play off and on
BUILD.gn / IDL / mojom / resource lists / feature registration updated so the final tree builds
